Method of Attack: Allows user or malicious threat actor to root devices (EngineerMode)
Can be abused to dump user's photos, videos, GPS, WiFi, Bluetooth, and various other logs; enables logging of various phone services and saves logs on SD card (OnePlusLogKit)
Attack Vector: Physical access to device to enable logging and collect logs later
Social engineering to trick users into enabling logging and sending log files
Malware enabling logging and data collection programmatically
Dial pad code *#800# to access OnePlusLogKit logging interface
